title: The Abyssal Eyes
description:
A custom resource pack that The Abyssal Monarch himself uses :]
- Made by AltiusGames
body: This resource pack is known as The Abyssal Eyes. There will most likely be an update for this pack soon, but this retextures the netherite sword, axe, and most importantly the Mace. For right now, just the mace, by imputting "The Traveller", it will turn into a cool Abyssal Bo Staff.
